title: Find alice's home
briefing: Everything about a user lives in one line of /etc/passwd:
objective: Find alice's home directory by reading /etc/passwd, and print the line that reveals it.
hints: alice has one line in /etc/passwd. Filter to it.
`grep alice /etc/passwd` — the sixth colon-field is her home directory.
explanation: /etc/passwd is world-readable and holds every account's uid, home and shell (passwords live in /etc/shadow, which is not readable). grep + cut reads it like any other colon-separated file.
